event_grindstone.why: 球球吐舌、很開心地在磨刀石上磨小刀、火花四濺；文字是「練這個會傷身，得想清楚喵」，還在猶豫、沒動手，主圖先畫成照做。石上也看不到刻著的捨招法。
event_grindstone.scene: SETTING on a small patch of grey stone floor: a long rectangular grey grindstone slab lies on a low pile of stacked grey stone blocks. Right behind the slab, standing on the floor, is a low upright stone tablet. Its front face is ENGRAVED with three simple carved pictures one above the other: a tiny stick-figure cat throwing a punch, a tiny stick-figure cat kicking with a big X carved over it, and a tiny stick-figure cat standing calmly (carved pictures only, no letters, no writing). Qiuqiu stands on the floor beside the grindstone, NOT touching it. He rests his chin on his right paw, his right elbow propped on his left forearm, and frowns thoughtfully at the carved pictures - hesitant and unsure. His mouth is closed: no tongue out, no smile. His small knife lies flat on the floor near his feet, untouched. Nothing is being sharpened: no sparks.

event_feifei_grindstone.why: 菲菲吐舌、興高采烈地磨小刀；文字是「連身體都會練壞……這法子真的值得嗎？」，應該是擔心、遲疑，不是已經開始練。
event_feifei_grindstone.scene: SETTING on a small patch of grey stone floor: a long rectangular grey grindstone slab lies on a low pile of stacked grey stone blocks. Right behind the slab, standing on the floor, is a low upright stone tablet. Its front face is ENGRAVED with three simple carved pictures one above the other: a tiny stick-figure cat throwing a punch, a tiny stick-figure cat kicking with a big X carved over it, and a tiny stick-figure cat standing calmly (carved pictures only, no letters, no writing). Feifei stands on the floor beside the grindstone, NOT touching it. Both of her paws are drawn up close together in front of her chest, and she looks at the carved pictures with a worried, doubtful face: eyebrows tilted up, small closed mouth, a tiny sweat drop. No tongue out, no smile. Her paws hold nothing; there is no knife anywhere. Nothing is being sharpened: no sparks.

event_feifei_grindstone_r0.why: 菲菲一手拿小刀、一手抓石塊，衝勁十足地在石面上刻劃、吐舌；文字是「磨到最後胸口發悶，喘得比平常還急」「胸口一直發虛，連站著都累」，圖完全沒有累或喘的樣子。
event_feifei_grindstone_r0.scene: The same grindstone and carved stone tablet as in reference image 3, on the same small patch of grey stone floor. Feifei has just finished practising and is exhausted. She sits on the floor in a tired kneeling position beside the grindstone, her RIGHT paw pressed flat against her chest, her mouth open, panting hard: two small white puffs of breath float right in front of her mouth. Sweat drops on her forehead, tired droopy half-closed eyes (both eyes the same). Her small knife lies flat on top of the grindstone slab. Her left paw rests on her knee; her paws hold nothing.
refs: bg/event_feifei_grindstone.webp

event_fengfeng_grindstone.why: 封封吐舌、開心地把小刀壓在磨刀石上磨；文字明寫「封封讀完，把手從石上拿開」「不是磨劍，是要改掉原來練熟的招式」。另外他頭後綁著紅布、脖子上沒有圍巾，造型像球球頭巾換色。
event_fengfeng_grindstone.scene: SETTING on a small patch of grey stone floor: a long rectangular grey grindstone slab lies on a low pile of stacked grey stone blocks. Right behind the slab, standing on the floor, is a low upright stone tablet. Its front face is ENGRAVED with three simple carved pictures one above the other: a tiny stick-figure cat throwing a punch, a tiny stick-figure cat kicking with a big X carved over it, and a tiny stick-figure cat standing calmly (carved pictures only, no letters, no writing). Fengfeng stands on the floor facing the carved tablet. He has just finished reading and taken his paw off the stone: his right paw hangs down at his side a little away from the tablet, not touching anything. Serious, grave expression, mouth closed, eyes on the carved pictures. His straight jian stays sheathed in the dark-brown scabbard at his waist; his paws hold nothing and nothing is being sharpened. His red scarf is wrapped around his NECK; NOTHING is tied on his head - no headband, no bandana.

event_fengfeng_shortcut_scroll_r0.why: 封封空手擺出掌擊姿勢（是球球那張的換色），身上看不到劍；文字整段在講劍：「出手快了，收劍時卻接連卡住」「出得去，收不回來」。驗收追加：第一輪新圖的卷軸畫成三格乾淨小人圖，跟主圖（滿幅狂草墨跡加一道墨滴）不是同一卷，改回主圖那卷。
event_fengfeng_shortcut_scroll_r0.scene: SETTING: the short stone-block pillar standing on the floor with a long paper scroll hanging down its front, EXACTLY as in reference image 3 - the SAME scroll: its whole surface is covered from top to bottom with big wild black ink brush swirls and scribbles (abstract brush strokes, not readable letters) and one long black ink drip running down its middle, the rolled bottom end curling on the floor. Do NOT draw neat step-by-step figure drawings or panels on the scroll. Fengfeng stands on the floor in front of the scroll, trying to put his sword away and failing: his RIGHT paw firmly grips the hilt of his straight jian, the blade is pushed halfway into the dark-brown scabbard at his waist and STUCK at the scabbard mouth (half of the blade still showing above it). His LEFT paw holds the scabbard. Frustrated, annoyed face: gritted teeth, lowered eyebrows, a small sweat drop. Red scarf around his neck.

event_pigeon_lost_r1.why: 右上角那扇鐵窗是一塊獨立的石框，底下沒有牆連到地面，整塊窗框懸在半空中。其餘內容（鴿子飛走、忍具謝禮、信散一地）都對。
event_pigeon_lost_r1.scene: SETTING: a dungeon corner on a patch of stone floor, as in reference image 3: ONE continuous stone-block wall rises straight up from the floor (its bottom row of blocks sits on the floor), a lit wall torch on its left part, and a small barred iron window set high up INSIDE the same wall on the right - wall blocks all around the window and below it, all the way down to the floor. The grey POSTMAN PIGEON (navy postman cap, brown satchel) squeezes out through the window bars, wings spread, flying away outside. A broken brown strap dangles from one of the window bars. Qiuqiu stands on the floor below, reaching up with his right paw and catching a small green cloth gift pouch - the pouch sits in his closed paw. His mouth is open, calling after the pigeon. Several envelopes lie scattered flat on the floor around his feet.

event_feifei_rare_catnip_master_r0.why: 文字寫紙上「只畫著一隻大貓捏針的手勢……旁邊還畫了一個放鬆的手腕」，接著「針一滑，扎進了自己的手背」；圖上紙面畫的是三隻全身在踢腿、奔跑的貓，沒有手勢、沒有手腕，菲菲手上也沒有針。
event_feifei_rare_catnip_master_r0.scene: SETTING as in reference image 3: a round patch of catnip on a low stone rim, a big cat-shaped hollow pressed flat into the catnip with a small tuft of grey fur in it, a small glowing stone lantern, a low stone railing, a big full moon behind, and an orange gourd wine bottle with a red cord lying tipped over on its side on the grass. Feifei kneels inside the cat-shaped hollow. An old sheet of paper lies spread flat on her lap, held down by her LEFT paw. On the paper there is ONE big simple ink drawing of a cat's paw pinching a needle between its fingers (a close-up of the hand gesture), and next to it one small drawing of a loose, relaxed wrist (ink pictures only, no writing, no whole cats). Her RIGHT paw pinches one thin needle between its fingers, the wrist loose, copying the drawing. A tiny red dot on the back of her right paw where she just pricked herself. She winces in pain. HER FACE HAS EXACTLY ONE MOUTH, under her nose, drawn as small gritted teeth - no second mouth anywhere, nothing mouth-like on her cheeks; both eyes half closed the same way.
